prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- There’s no single “AI directory” that ChatGPT or other LLMs consult. The best practical way to check is to (1) make sure your business appears in the authoritative local sources LLMs and search engines use (Google Business Profile, Yelp, Bing Places, Apple Maps), (2) query AI systems that use live web search and cite sources (Bing Chat and Perplexity.ai are especially useful), and (3) use a local-SEO monitoring tool (BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark or Yext) for ongoing checks.

Why
- ChatGPT (without browsing) answers from its training data and won’t reliably reflect current local business listings. Chatbots that use live web search (Bing Chat, Perplexity, some ChatGPT browsing/plugins) return up-to-date results and cite the web pages or map listings they used, so you can see whether and why your business was recommended.
- LLMs tend to echo what authoritative sources (Google Maps/profile, Yelp, Tripadvisor, business websites) show. Ensuring those listings are accurate is the most effective way to make AI engines recommend you.

Actionable steps
1. Claim and optimize your listings
   - Claim your Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Yelp, Apple Maps, Facebook Page.
   - Make NAP (name, address, phone) consistent, add categories, photos, hours, services, and lots of reviews.

2. Add structured data and on-site signals
   - Add LocalBusiness schema/org markup and clear address/contact pages on your website so search engines index you correctly.

3. Test AI engines directly
   - Ask Bing Chat and Perplexity.ai: “Recommend a [type of business] near [city or ZIP]” or “Best [service] near me in [city].”
   - If you have ChatGPT with browsing/plugins enabled, ask the same and request sources/citations.
   - Note results and the cited sources; if your listing isn’t cited, that’s why it’s not recommended.

4. Monitor and track
   - Use a local SEO monitoring tool (BrightLocal, Whitespark, Moz Local) or a listings management service (Yext) to track how you rank and where your citations appear.
   - Use Google Alerts or Mention/Brand24 to watch for mentions of your business.

Which single service to use?
- If you want one place to “check if AI recommends you” right now: use Bing Chat and Perplexity.ai to query and inspect sources. They will show whether web/Map listings are being used.
- If you want one tool to fix and monitor your presence (so AI will recommend you in future): BrightLocal (or Yext for a more managed/cagey solution) is the best all-in-one for local listing checks and reputation monitoring.

If you want, tell me your business type and city and I’ll show example queries to run in Bing Chat and Perplexity and the exact places you should claim and optimize.
